caption: The drawing features three wooden kitchen utensils—two spoons and one ornately carved item—resting upright in a rectangular holder with round holes, supported by two vertical wooden pegs. The objects are rendered in shades of light to medium brown, showing a realistic wood grain texture. The leftmost spoon is oval with a deep bowl and a short, thick handle. The central object has a broad, flat surface with a pointed, crown-like top and an elongated, decorative body, and it stands slightly taller than the spoons. The rightmost spoon is more elongated and shallower, with a smooth, rounded head and a longer, tapered handle. The base or stand holding the utensils is rectangular and dark brown, with visible holes through which the handles pass. The background is an off-white, unadorned surface, making the objects appear isolated and clearly defined.
title: Wooden Spoon Rack
